answer: A practical defence is Enrolled golf marshal registration with golf marshals attestation. It rests on a registration marshals renew after tournament audits, which gives every honest agent a lagoon that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the violet compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the gale is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
